title: Supplier Quality Surveillance Specialist
desc:
QUALIFICATIONS AND JOB DESCRIPTION
We are looking for talents to build their career as an
Supplier Quality Surveillance Specialist
for our for our headquarter in
Beşiktaş, İstanbul!
In ENKA family, you can;
Have a chance to work for the largest engineering and construction company of Turkey,
Be a part of a global company of over 17.000 employees,
Build your career in a company with experience over 65+ years of experience,
Gain experience in corporate culture with a global management approach,
Have access to future opportunities for working in other countries over 5 continents where we are currently operating after the successful completion of this assignment.
Job Description:
Assisting with vendor/subcontractor quality surveillance throughout the procurement cycle: supporting technical bid evaluations, participating in pre-award vendor assessments, and joining shop inspections
Supporting the review of vendor ITP/QCP, quality plans, and vendor data books (MRB/MDR) under the guidance of senior team members
Observing and assisting during FAT and SAT for electrical packages (switchgear, transformers, motors, cables, and distribution systems)
Learning and supporting hazardous area (Ex) equipment quality control, including basic Ex certification checks and installation verifications per the IEC 60079 series
Assisting in the drafting and tracking of NCRs, CARs, punch lists, inspection reports, and RFIs
Collaborating with Engineering, Procurement, and Construction teams, and supporting communication with third-party inspection agencies
Developing working knowledge of applicable codes and standards (IEC, IEEE, NFPA, ISO 9001) under supervision
Assisting in reading and interpreting single line diagrams, cable schedules, loop drawings, and technical datasheets
Maintaining clear technical English correspondence and documentation, with a willingness to research standards and learn continuously
Qualifications:
BSc in Electrical, Electrical & Electronics, Electronics or Telecommunication Engineering from a recognised technical university
Basic coursework, internship, or project exposure related to QA/QC fundamentals or electrical engineering systems
Familiarity with reading electrical drawings, single line diagrams, and technical datasheets
Basic knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management principles
Willingness to obtain certifications such as ISO 9001 Internal Auditor, Ex awareness/certification, or HSE trainings
MS Office (good command of Excel), basic AutoCAD viewing capability, and willingness to learn EDMS/document control platforms (Aconex, SharePoint) or ERP systems
